title: Combined particle-level polarized dijet and jet-shape shower-spin measurement at 510 GeV

declustering.definition: Follow the harder branch on the primary Lund plane; select its highest-kT passing splitting. Follow the harder branch of that splitting's soft branch for the secondary plane and accumulate signed plane-angle increments recursively.

eeec.triplets: all unordered constituent triplets, deterministic closest-pair choice, exact event-local bin accumulation

pt_average.description: Average transverse momentum of the leading dijet

dijet_ht.description: Scalar transverse-momentum sum of the leading dijet

delta_phi.description: Azimuthal separation of the leading jets

abs_delta_eta.description: Absolute pseudorapidity separation of the leading jets

eta_boost.description: Mean pseudorapidity of the leading jets

cos2_delta_phi.description: Cosine of twice the leading-jet azimuthal separation

interjet_dpsi11_kt10.description: Signed angle between the selected primary splittings of jets 1 and 2

resolved_radiation.third_jet_angle: signed angle from the beam-leading-jet plane to the leading-third-jet plane about the leading-jet axis
resolved_radiation.fourth_jet_angle: signed angle from the leading-third-jet plane to the leading-fourth-jet plane about the leading-jet axis
resolved_radiation.conditional_outputs: cos(2 psi) and sine null moments versus pT3/pT1 or pT4/pT1

shard_block_covariance.block: one equal-ordinal, equal-size shard from every helicity sample in a family
shard_block_covariance.family_combination: spin-on and spin-off covariance matrices are added because the generated families are independent
products: spin-on-minus-spin-off chi2 using a Moore-Penrose inverse
